value.rationale: Zeros of Fourier transforms of self-similar measures govern orthogonal-exponential frequency differences. For the canonical symmetric triadic digit measure with a varying middle weight, the theorem gives a complete analytic-multiplicity density spectrum, a sharp nonvanishing threshold, a countable dense set of explicitly quantized downward jumps, and a conserved multiplicity-weighted density. These are natural invariants for a full one-parameter IFS family, not isolated numerical instances. A general Fourier-basis theorem is not claimed.
